name: strategist-failed
notes: Campaign safety: the strategist's watcher answers a checkpoint with an error instead of directives, as it does when it cannot reach Claude (an expired login). The player is told why on screen ("notices": true, with a screenshot), play goes on under the previous directives, and no second checkpoint is asked before the next one is due. Needs no watcher.
commands: ai.strategist fail Failed to authenticate: OAuth session expired and could not be refreshed
info: [(e['t'], e['ev'], e.get('error')) for e in events('strategist')]
